title: docs(sprints): register SG-GEOM-AUTH-001 — Smart Guitar pre-CAD observation record (reported owner statements, not repository-verified)

diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The current Smart Guitar owner-stated working values exist only in session notes. docs/SPRINTS_MAINTENANCE.md Rule 6 forbids chat-only notes as the system of record, which is how the 4.5 deg op20_status survived three supersessions unnoticed. No other SPRINTS entry carries body height, the 12th-fret attachment, the neck-angle band or the neck-pocket dispositions.
diff_articulation.what_changed: Appends one DATA INTEGRITY sprint section before ## COMPLETED. It records the owner's 2026-09-20 pre-CAD working-value set with a per-quantity disposition table (521.8 working value / 528.1 superseded / 438.15 reference only), the pre-CAD-to-CAM authority chain, the provisional body-height-to-body_length_mm equivalence, the quantities derived from 528.1 that must be recomputed before reuse, and the contradictions re-read on main. No record file, schema or calculator is amended. Review pass 2026-09-20. Four findings from the risk assessment are incorporated: (1) the 12th-fret ruling is recorded as contradicting the join-fret fields themselves, naming the three Smart Guitar fields that carry one (v1 neck.neck_length.body_join_fret 'TBD 19 or 20', setup neck_relief.body_join_fret 19, sweep neck_joint_fret 19) and explicitly excluding explorer_baseline.neck_joint_fret 22 as a fact about the Explorer; (2) the scale staleness is widened from the solver block to smart_guitar_geometry.scale_mm 628.65, a governing field, against v1's revised 647.7, with parent_models scale values excluded for the same reason; (3) 26.59 is relabelled from an asserted pocket requirement to what the record actually holds -- a neck-and-fretboard stack at the 12th fret, sourced from the Explorer, with no derivation connecting it to a pocket depth -- and the 17.86 floor figure is marked as inheriting that ungoverned premise; (4) the 47.0 claim is scoped to the grep that supports it. Three further defects found while verifying: the record states the owner neck-angle band as 1.5-2.5 deg three times at setup_spec:43 while this entry states 1.5-2.0, which is now flagged unreconciled rather than silently resolved; the solver sweep was cited from its 10-13mm rows only, and the full nine-row table gates GREEN from 1.13 to 3.31 deg so it discriminates nothing and is now marked not usable as manufacturing evidence; and the record's own note that the heel stack is unmeasured is quoted, since it independently refutes using a 12th-fret figure as the shoulder requirement. Pass 3, owner-directed 2026-09-20. The entry no longer presents anything as a ruling to defend. Status line reads TEMPORARY OBSERVATION RECORD, PENDING OWNER DECISION, IT ESTABLISHES NO AUTHORITY. A scope blockquote states that the design is under active revision, that the parameters will be finalized by the owner once CAD has produced an acceptable model, that every Part A figure is provisional and may change including those that look settled, and that the record deliberately does NOT ask the owner to adjudicate anything yet because resolving a value before CAD would fix a number the model is about to determine. The former 'Geometry package -- owner ruling' table becomes PART A -- WORKING VALUES (IN REVISION . NOT AUTHORITY), and 'CURRENT WORKING AUTHORITY' becomes 'WORKING VALUE'. The contradictions section becomes PART B -- CONTRADICTION LOG (EVIDENCE ONLY) with a banner stating it records what the repository says and nothing about what is correct, and that no bullet may be read as a correction or a value to build from. PART C -- WHAT MUST HAPPEN, AND WHO SIGNS carries the close trigger, now rewritten so every item resolves against the accepted CAD model rather than by choosing between recorded values on paper, plus a new item 8 requiring the accepted model and the signoff, plus an Owner signoff block with four checkboxes. The authority chain diagram is redrawn to show two open gates -- CAD MODEL ACCEPTED BY OWNER and OWNER SIGNOFF -- instead of one. The neck-angle band conflict is downgraded from a demand for an owner call to a logged conflict that CAD settles. The op20_status safety stop is strengthened to say the correct angle is not yet known by anyone, including this entry, and that the stop lifts when the model is accepted and Part C is signed, not when this PR merges. Heading levels corrected to #### / ##### so the parts nest inside the sprint instead of becoming siblings of ## COMPLETED. Pass 4 (2026-09-21). Provenance: Part A relabelled REPORTED OWNER STATEMENTS — SOURCE NOT REPOSITORY-PRESERVED / NOT INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIABLE HERE, distinguishing reported provenance from verified provenance and stating that transcription into SPRINTS.md confers no authority; 'system-of-record starting point' narrowed to 'repository observation index and reconciliation starting point'. Datum semantics: the 12th-fret finding becomes a POTENTIAL SEMANTIC CONFLICT and the claim that the join-fret fields move with it is withdrawn; the body height / body_length_mm equivalence becomes a CANDIDATE MAPPING with neither substitutable for the other; the two neck-angle bands are presented as unreconciled reports with neither selected; the 26.59 mm finding now says no arithmetic relationship between the 12th-fret stack and heel pocket depth is defined by the source record; the sweep conclusion is labelled an evidence-quality conclusion rather than a geometry conclusion, with its four bases named. Authorization: the safety stop says no neck angle is currently established as an accepted manufacturing value in the repository (replacing a claim about what anyone knows), and states that removing READY would neutralise an unsafe instruction without establishing a replacement angle. Close logic split into Gate 1 SAFETY (independent, does not wait for CAD), Gate 2 CAD / RECONCILIATION (the five quantities that genuinely need the model) and Gate 3 AUTHORITY / SIGNOFF, whose A1 requires each operational quantity to resolve to one authoritative source - accepted CAD, a governed specification, or an owner-authenticated record - rather than forcing non-CAD-native values such as PU_NECK and the Les Paul reference into CAD. Signoff converted from a fenced checkbox block to greppable Markdown fields with its scope stated. The cross-repository reference is marked historical evidence captured 2026-09-20, not a live dependency and not authority. Historical CI detail removed from the registry in favour of 'current-head CI is the merge gate'. Local source records pinned by FULL blob object id. M9 recorded as provisional registry numbering with the M7/M8 branch-state dependency named. Registry placement documented: M9 is a child of ## DATA INTEGRITY alongside Sprints M1-M6, which a review had misread as ## DEFERRED MAINTENANCE.

intent: Give the pre-CAD geometry reconciliation a system-of-record observation record that preserves authority distinctions without claiming CAD verification. Review pass 2026-09-20 addresses the PR #388 risk assessment. The entry is relabelled an OBSERVATION RECORD whose arithmetic is an observation about the records and never derived geometry authority; the op20_status safety stop is promoted to a blockquote at the top stating that nothing has been corrected and OP20 is not safe to run at any angle; the cross-repo source is given as a full SHA with a public permalink and both file paths; and the cited record files are pinned by blob id, since line numbers drift. Owner instruction 2026-09-20: the Smart Guitar design is under active revision and the parameters will be finalized by the owner once the CAD operation has produced an acceptable model. The entry is restructured to say that explicitly. It is labelled a TEMPORARY OBSERVATION RECORD PENDING OWNER DECISION that ESTABLISHES NO AUTHORITY; it is split into three visually separated parts -- Part A working values (in revision, not authority), Part B contradiction log (evidence only, records nothing about what is correct), Part C what must happen and who signs; and it carries an owner signoff block that must be filled in before any part of it is operational. Owner-source provenance is explicit: owner-originated Part A values are owner statements from the 2026-09-20 design session, with no repository-preserved source yet identified; registration does not elevate them to authority. Review pass 2026-09-21 resolves the remaining findings. Part A values are reclassified as REPORTED OWNER STATEMENTS whose source is NOT REPOSITORY-PRESERVED and NOT INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIABLE HERE: the repository preserves the existence of the report, it does not authenticate the underlying statement, and the values are explicitly not accepted geometry inputs. 'System-of-record starting point' is narrowed to 'repository observation index and reconciliation starting point'. The 12th-fret finding is downgraded from a contradiction to a POTENTIAL SEMANTIC CONFLICT because the repository does not establish that fretboard/body attachment, body_join_fret, neck_relief.body_join_fret and smart_guitar_sweep.neck_joint_fret name the same physical datum, and the downstream 'these fields move together' assertion is withdrawn. The safety-stop boundary is made explicit: this entry records the NEED for a separate, independently reviewed safety change and authorizes nothing, and the Part C signoff governs adoption of reconciled geometry only and does not gate that safety change.

Every line citation in the entry re-read at the pinned blobs: setup_spec :30 scale_mm 628.65, :43 the 1.5-2.5 band and the BINDING UNKNOWN heel note, :52 op20_status, :58 neck_relief.body_join_fret 19, :75 'Bolt-on join at ~19th fret', :162 explorer_baseline.neck_joint_fret 22, :171 smart_guitar_sweep.neck_joint_fret 19, :172 scale_length_mm 628.65; v1 :250 op20_status, :795 scale_length_mm 647.7, :826 body_join_fret 'TBD - 19 or 20'.

Remaining uses of 'system of record' and 'authenticated' are the explanatory passages that define what the entry is NOT.

verification._evidence_class_note: commands_run holds only entries that were actually executed. Observations made by reading files or structure are in manual_verifications; results tied to an earlier commit or to pre-existing repository state are in historical_evidence; material outside this repository is in external_sources. Earlier passes listed all of these under commands_run, which made manual inspection look re-runnable. CORRECTED 2026-09-21 after review of PR #388: commands_run previously held six entries that were not literally executable - a 'git rev-parse origin/main:<both spec paths>' placeholder flagged in review, a '--changed-files <merge-base diff>' placeholder, and four entries written as prose ('on both specs'). Every entry has now been re-run against the current repository state and records its real command and output. One result claim was also corrected: the repo-wide 47.0 grep returns two matches, not one.

architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: The one low item is the finding ID. SG-GEOM-AUTH-001 is a finding ID inside the sprint, not a registered namespace; promoting SG to SPRINT_NAMESPACE_STANDARD is an owner ruling and nothing else references the ID yet, so renaming it is a single-file edit.

behavior_change: None. SPRINTS.md and this manifest only. No Smart Guitar instrument JSON, schema, calculator, CAM, workflow, test or geometry value is touched; op20_status is NOT modified in either spec; physical-cut status is unchanged and DO-NOT-CUT remains in force. The entry states in several places that it establishes no authority, that Part A values are reported rather than verified and are not accepted geometry inputs, and that it authorizes no cut, no angle selection and no separate safety PR.
